records.receipt-1:
On 31 August 2020, the Security Council concluded a written vote on draft S/2020/852, submitted by Indonesia. The draft proposed comprehensive prosecution, rehabilitation and reintegration strategies for foreign terrorist fighters and related cases. It received 14 votes in favour, one against and no abstentions. The United States cast the only negative vote. The draft was not adopted because that negative vote was cast by a permanent member. It created no new Council authority or requirements.

The United States vetoed the draft because it lacked a reference to repatriation. The US insisted that returning foreign terrorist fighters to their countries of origin or nationality was the essential first step.
records.receipt-2:
On 31 August 2020, the Security Council concluded a written vote on draft S/2020/852, submitted by Indonesia. The draft proposed comprehensive prosecution, rehabilitation and reintegration strategies for foreign terrorist fighters and related cases. It received 14 votes in favour, one against and no abstentions. The United States cast the only negative vote. The draft was not adopted because that negative vote was cast by a permanent member. It created no new Council authority or requirements.

Russia supported the draft to elaborate existing guidance on prosecution, rehabilitation, and reintegration while promoting accountability and international cooperation. However, it reserved the right to note that the draft failed to recognize the primary importance of repatriation from Syria and Iraq.
